## Problem

What does the core do, or fail to do, today? Use a synthetic example
(`example-owner`, `example-app`) rather than your own files.

## Proposed change

What should the core do instead?

## Before you submit

- [ ] The body names no repository, host, person, organisation, ticket key or profile name of my own.
- [ ] Every example is synthetic.
- [ ] I understand this repository is public.
